Team — reviewing for procurement. We use an automated risk scorer for invoice-only eligibility; triggers we look at: entity type, AML/PEP check, credit history (basic bureau search), contract value (< $10k/month), and whether an SOW has explicit deliverables and termination rights.

Preliminary read on NovaPulse: W9 and EIN present (good), estimated spend within threshold. The SOW looks standard — short, with straightforward deliverables. Two items to clear before I can approve:

1) Confirm tax/business address (we need registered address matching public filings)
2) Accounts-payable confirmation that invoices will be sent to accounts-payable@novapulse.ai and will be paid within 30 days — we prefer invoices to reference a Redwood billing contact.

If both are OK I can push a conditional approval with the following guardrails:
- Timeboxed: invoice-only allowed for 90 days max for this pilot;
- Spend cap: $15k total across the pilot period without PO;
- Audit evidence: sample invoice + payment confirmation for the first invoice is required;
- Automatic re-eval if monthly spend exceeds $8k.

If you (Marissa/So o jin) want faster turnaround, I can provisionally approve pending AP confirmation and address verification; final sign-off after docs.
